description: Test suite for the submit handler, burst coalescer, and platform-specific fallback logic in the TUI (terminal user interface) component of the project.

methods.name: createSubmitHarness
methods.description: Sets up a testing harness for submit handler functions, providing mocked functions and test environment.

methods.name: createSubmitBurstCoalescer
methods.description: Creates a function that coalesces rapid submits into a multiline submission if enabled, with configurable timing.

methods.name: shouldEnableWindowsGitBashPasteFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback behavior should be enabled based on platform and environment variables.
